run.oracle_evaluation_scope: exact bounded CPU polling-objective calls; final audit counted separately; no quantum oracle calls
run.virtual_budget_scope: CPU-control annotations only; no real or modeled quantum shot consumption
run.method: deterministic exact-moment CPU control; no sampling or QPU execution
run.timing_scope: measured CPU reference and controller times; no hardware performance measurement

settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep
settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.method: independent all-assignment XOR enumeration and algebraic phase/bit-pair mixer evolution
